selection_protocol.best_checkpoint_rule: minimum frozen selection-validation aggregate BPB; deterministic tie-break to earliest checkpoint

authority_gate.exact_blocker: DATA-301 terminates blocked: the exact DATA-300 v2 inventory is infeasible under source-family diversity and nonempty selection-validation requirements; corpus_frozen=false, corpus_identity=null, and authorized balanced no-replay capacity=0. Starting training would violate the exact-frozen-candidate and no-replay requirements.
authority_gate.no_substitution: Do not substitute DATA-25, project-authored, synthetic, prebuild candidate bytes, or any nonterminal corpus.

unblock_requirements: A successor frozen corpus contract and terminal build must publish corpus and shard identities with nonzero exact one-pass balanced no-replay optimized-loss capacity.
At least two independently authorized training source families per UA, EN, and code stratum must satisfy the frozen balance/diversity authority without replay.
Exact Wave-3 quality and privacy authorities must pass on the successor inventory.
Exact/near dedup, evaluation decontamination, cluster-safe split, and full post-split unique-loss accounting must be terminal for that same corpus identity.
At least one nonempty immutable selection-validation authority required by the run must be terminal and proven disjoint from train and final-test bytes.
Two independent clean builds must yield byte-identical corpus/shard identities.

Only after those gates pass may LEARN-317 run D05, train locally up to the unique one-pass cap, select the best checkpoint on selection-validation, verify fresh-process resume, freeze selection, and then open final-test exactly once for reporting.
